messages:
Jamie Chen: @channel quick sync — we're rolling out the v2 API & model-swap deprecation next month. I started a doc draft for the migration playbook, need help aligning SDK snippets and example apps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1432 :eyes:
Sasha Patel: Thanks — linking up with infra. Do we have a canonical "model map" for v1->v2 equivalents? that'll affect code examples.
Jamie Chen: Good q. Zara pulled together a mapping spreadsheet yesterday, see link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/model-mapping (will attach to PR)
Zara Lee: yep, spreadsheet is current. I'll paste the table into the PR as a snippet. Also suggest we add a short "behavioral diffs" section — callers should know when responses may change.
Matt Rivera: I'll update the JS/TS SDK snippets. Breaking changes: client ctor options, streaming API name change. Plan to include both v1 and v2 example side-by-side.
Sasha Patel: Also need a note about rate limit behavior and fallback routing — infra will provide conservative guidance on quotas.
Jamie Chen: Action items: Zara add table to PR, Matt update snippets + add compatibility wrapper example, Sasha provide infra note, I'll write migration checklist and comms blurb.
Matt Rivera: Draft of compatibility wrapper (TS):
```ts
// compat-wrapper.ts
import {V2Client} from '@redwood/sdk';
export function makeCompat(apiKey:string){
  const client = new V2Client({apiKey, legacyMode: true});
  return { generate: (p)=> client.chat.complete({prompt: p}) };
}
```

Matt Rivera: Will push this to the PR and a runnable sample app link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/compat-sample
Jamie Chen: Nice — include tests that assert token counting differences, so customers can validate cost delta.
Zara Lee: I'll add a short "what to test" checklist: 1) latency, 2) tokens per response, 3) output style regression.
Sasha Patel: Quick question — do we want to include a rollback snippet showing fallback to hosted v1 endpoints? That might encourage temporary reliance.
Jamie Chen: Let's add a fallback pattern but flag it as short-term only. We need legal sign-off on the deprecation notice too, I'll ping legal after PR is ready.
deploy-bot: PR #1432 has been opened by jamie. CI: pending.
Matt Rivera: CI red — linter errors in examples. I'll fix in a follow-up commit.
Jamie Chen: no rush on perfect formatting, want content live so solutions partners can start mapping.
Zara Lee: tagging internal docs reviewers: @docs-team :wave:
Sasha Patel: timeline check — plan to publish migration guide 2026-04-15, announcement 2026-04-20, deprecation window starts 2026-05-15.
Jamie Chen: dates acked. I'll send calendar invites for a quick review on 2026-04-07.
Matt Rivera: LGTM for snippet approach. I'll also add Python examples with the same compatibility wrapper pattern.
Jamie Chen: thanks all. I'll update PR description with the timeline and next steps.
Sasha Patel: thanks — will add infra's note in a new comment once I have exact rate info.
deploy-bot: CI passed on #1432, branch deployed to staging :shipit:
Jamie Chen: merging tomorrow unless objections. If anyone wants to do a final pass tonight, ping me.
Zara Lee: can do a quick copy edit tonight.
Matt Rivera: gave minor nits, no blockers.
Jamie Chen: merging now. Thanks team :heart:
